note.zh-TW: 課程的門檻只當「課程參考值」顯示，不計分；流動負債為 0 時網站顯示 N/A，不顯示無限大。
note.en: The course threshold is shown only as a course reference value and is not scored; when current liabilities are nil the site shows N/A rather than infinity.

definition.zh-TW:
只拿能很快變成現金的流動資產來和流動負債相比，看短期債務能被涵蓋幾倍；存貨和預付費用不容易馬上變現，不算在內。

它比流動比率保守，英文又叫 acid-test ratio，也就是酸性測試比率。
definition.en:
Compares only the current assets that can quickly be turned into cash with current liabilities, showing how many times short-term debts are covered; inventories and prepayments, which cannot be realised quickly, are left out.

It is more conservative than the current ratio and is also called the acid-test ratio.

example.zh-TW: 所有數字都在資產負債表上。流動負債為 0 時比率沒有定義，網站顯示 N/A，不顯示無限大。
example.en: All figures are on the balance sheet. When current liabilities are zero the ratio is undefined and the site shows N/A rather than infinity.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為存貨很快就能賣掉，所以不必扣。存貨要先賣出、再等客戶付款才變成現金，中間可能卡很久甚至賣不掉，所以速動比率把它排除。
misconception.en: Assuming inventory can be left in because it will sell soon. Inventory must first be sold and then collected before it becomes cash, which can take a long time or never happen. That is why the quick ratio leaves it out.

formula.zh-TW: 速動比率 ＝ 速動資產 ÷ 流動負債。課程版的速動資產是現金及約當現金 ＋ 應收帳款 ＋ 短期放款；年報版用流動資產 － 存貨 － 預付費用。
formula.en: Quick ratio = quick assets ÷ current liabilities. The course version defines quick assets as cash and cash equivalents + trade receivables + short-term loans receivable; the annual report version uses current assets － inventories － prepayments.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是國際通用的說法；計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準，題目會指定用哪一個版本計分。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios; the name follows international usage. The calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry, and each question states which version it scores against.
